name: Lantern of Revealing
summary: A lantern whose light makes Invisible creatures and objects visible.

stats.effect: While lit, this hooded lantern burns for 6 hours on 1 pint of oil, shedding {ref:glossary/bright-light} in a 30-foot radius and {ref:glossary/dim-light} for an additional 30 feet. Invisible creatures and objects are visible as long as they are in the lantern's Bright Light. You can take a {ref:glossary/utilize} action to lower the hood, reducing the lantern's light to Dim Light in a 5-foot radius.
